wbkw9l7gge: Device control is expressed in groups (of media, of users) and in policy rules with allow or deny entries. A removable media policy rule can allow reading and deny writing, for example, or allow only drives from an approved manufacturer and model.

1gslg1hinr6: ## A risk signal becomes an access decision
2fvxvqb2c1z: Defender for Endpoint assesses a risk level for each device from its active alerts. That level is a signal. For it to count, it must be turned into a compliance state in Intune, then Microsoft Entra Conditional Access must be asked to grant access only to compliant devices. The chain therefore has at least four links: detection, connector, compliance, access.
3her5kkoyy: The business need is to protect data without paralyzing the business. A chain that works too well (no filter on false positives, no grace period) can lock out hundreds of people because of a poorly calibrated alert.
